scope: observed command catalogue, not capability or creative acceptance

commands.label: Edit Type
commands.params: {"layer":id?,"text":str? (replace all, styles kept),"replace":{"start":char,"end":char,"text":str}?,"runs":[{"start":char,"end":char,…character keys}]?,"box":[x,y,w,h]? (to paragraph text),"point":[x,y]? (to point text),"move":[dx,dy]?,"transform":[a,b,c,d,e,f]?,"antialias":"none|sharp|crisp|strong|smooth"?,"name":str?}

commands.label: Type Layer Info
commands.params: {"layer":id?} → text, runs/paragraphs (char offsets + styles), shape, transform, laid-out lines (text space px), bounds

commands.label: Vertical
commands.params: {"layer":id?} (stored and saved; rendered horizontally for now)

commands.label: Resolve Missing Fonts…
commands.params: {"map":{"Missing Family":"Installed Family"}?} (no map: list the missing families)

commands.label: Save Default Type Styles
commands.params: {} (from the active type layer; new type layers start from them)

commands.label: New Character Style
commands.params: {"name":str?,"attrs":{model fields as in type.info ("size_pt":36,"font_family":"Inter","align":"Center",…) or Character/Paragraph panel keys as in type.setStyle ("size":36,"font":"Inter","color":"#rrggbb","align":"center",…)}?,"fromSelection":bool=true (start from the targeted text's formatting),"apply":bool=false,"layer":id? | "layers":[id]? (default: the selected type layers),"range":[startChar,endChar]? (one layer; default all text)} → {"id","name"}

commands.label: Character Style Options
commands.params: {"id":u32 (paragraph: 0 = Basic Paragraph),"name":str?,"attrs":{model fields as in type.info ("size_pt":36,"font_family":"Inter","align":"Center",…) or Character/Paragraph panel keys as in type.setStyle ("size":36,"font":"Inter","color":"#rrggbb","align":"center",…)},"replace":bool=false (drop attributes not given),"clear":[field]?} (text using the style updates, overrides kept)

commands.label: Apply Character Style
commands.params: {"id":u32|0|null (0/null: None / Basic Paragraph),"clearOverrides":bool=false (Alt-click),"layer":id? | "layers":[id]? (default: the selected type layers),"range":[startChar,endChar]? (one layer; default all text)}

commands.label: Redefine Character Style
commands.params: {"id":u32? (default: the targeted text's style),"layer":id? | "layers":[id]? (default: the selected type layers),"range":[startChar,endChar]? (one layer; default all text)} (the style takes the formatting of the start of the targeted text)

commands.label: Clear Override
commands.params: {"layer":id? | "layers":[id]? (default: the selected type layers),"range":[startChar,endChar]? (one layer; default all text)}

commands.label: List Character Styles
commands.params: {"layer":id? | "layers":[id]? (default: the selected type layers),"range":[startChar,endChar]? (one layer; default all text)} → {"styles":[{"id","name",attributes,"resolved"}],"current":{"character":id|null (mixed),"characterOverride":bool,"paragraph":id|null,"paragraphOverride":bool}}

commands.label: New Paragraph Style
commands.params: {"name":str?,"attrs":{model fields as in type.info ("size_pt":36,"font_family":"Inter","align":"Center",…) or Character/Paragraph panel keys as in type.setStyle ("size":36,"font":"Inter","color":"#rrggbb","align":"center",…)}?,"fromSelection":bool=true (start from the targeted text's formatting),"apply":bool=false,"layer":id? | "layers":[id]? (default: the selected type layers),"range":[startChar,endChar]? (one layer; default all text)} → {"id","name"}

commands.label: Paragraph Style Options
commands.params: {"id":u32 (paragraph: 0 = Basic Paragraph),"name":str?,"attrs":{model fields as in type.info ("size_pt":36,"font_family":"Inter","align":"Center",…) or Character/Paragraph panel keys as in type.setStyle ("size":36,"font":"Inter","color":"#rrggbb","align":"center",…)},"replace":bool=false (drop attributes not given),"clear":[field]?} (text using the style updates, overrides kept)

commands.label: Apply Paragraph Style
commands.params: {"id":u32|0|null (0/null: None / Basic Paragraph),"clearOverrides":bool=false (Alt-click),"layer":id? | "layers":[id]? (default: the selected type layers),"range":[startChar,endChar]? (one layer; default all text)}

commands.label: Redefine Paragraph Style
commands.params: {"id":u32? (default: the targeted text's style),"layer":id? | "layers":[id]? (default: the selected type layers),"range":[startChar,endChar]? (one layer; default all text)} (the style takes the formatting of the start of the targeted text)

commands.label: Clear Override
commands.params: {"layer":id? | "layers":[id]? (default: the selected type layers),"range":[startChar,endChar]? (one layer; default all text)}

commands.label: List Paragraph Styles
commands.params: {"layer":id? | "layers":[id]? (default: the selected type layers),"range":[startChar,endChar]?
